name: Wirey
tagline: Runs a daily AI news pipeline: story sweep, wire-style script, voiceover, edit gate.
description: Each day it sweeps the previous day's AI, technology and policy developments for the few items worth your attention, then drafts a wire-style script and voiceover and holds at an edit gate until you clear it.
author: Farzad
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
